headline: 10-year Treasury yield hits highest level since 2007
detail: This is the main driver for your portfolio. Higher yields make borrowing more expensive and can pressure growth stocks, especially leveraged ones like SOXL and SPAL. It also makes your tech holdings less attractive relative to safer assets.
rec: Consider trimming SOXL and SPAL if they show further weakness, as this yield trend is a headwind.

headline: Fed will hike at least two times over the next year
detail: This confirms the market's expectation of higher interest rates. This is a negative for your leveraged tech positions, as it increases borrowing costs and can lead to further valuation compression.
rec: No action based on this headline alone, but it reinforces the bearish outlook for leveraged tech.

headline: U.S. crude oil rises back above $104
detail: Rising oil prices can contribute to inflation concerns, which in turn fuels expectations of higher interest rates. This indirectly impacts your tech holdings by reinforcing the hawkish Fed narrative.
rec: This headline is a secondary driver; focus on the interest rate implications.
